entities.summary: José Ignacio "Nacho" Rodilla Gil is a former Spanish professional basketball player. Standing at 192 cm, Rodilla used to play as point guard. His jersey number 11 was retired by Valencia Basket. Rodilla was also a member of the Spain national basketball team.
